fix(au): timestamps hold across time zones and daylight saving (#39) (#41)

Durations, expiry and the reservation lease compare in UTC (a naive time read
as local). FileSystemStore keeps each time naive local and adds its UTC offset
beside it, so a reader elsewhere reads the same instant and an older au still
reads naive times. HTTP timing carries offsets. In-memory times stay naive.
